{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the sales data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Convert 'revenue' from string to float, coercing errors to NaN
df['revenue'] = pd.to_numeric(df['revenue'], errors='coerce')

# Check for any invalid conversions (NaN)
invalid_revenue = df[df['revenue'].isna()]
invalid_revenue_count = len(invalid_revenue)

# Check if any rows have status 'COMPLETED' but revenue NaN
completed_invalid = invalid_revenue[invalid_revenue['status'] == 'completed']

invalid_revenue_count, len(completed_invalid)"}
